name: Cleaving Attack
description: Attack close enemies in front of you.

name: Improved Critical
description: Crit on 19+ with a chosen weapon or spell.

name: Precise Attack
description: -1 to damage rolls, +3 to attack rolls.

name: Power Attack
description: -1 to attack rolls, +3 to damage rolls.

name: Shield Other
description: Close ally gains a bonus to AC equal to your shields for one round.

name: Shield Slam
description: Use your move action to attack with shield.

name: Combat Casting
description: +1 to spell casting checks. +2 at level 4 and then +3 at level 8.

name: Embue Spell
description: +1 DC to spell casting check, store spell in a weapon or ammunition for up to 1 hour.

name: Empower Spell
description: +1 DC to spell casting check, +1 dice added to spell.

name: Initiate
description: Learn a tier 1 spell from any spell list.

name: Transform Spell
description: +1 DC to spell casting check, change spell's damage type.

name: Quicken Spell
description: +3 DC to spell casting check, use your move action to cast a spell.

name: Complex Person
description: +1 background experience, cannot conflict with existing background.

name: Diehard
description: +3 rounds to your death timer when ununconscious.
